summary: mask_secrets parameters: required input string and mask_placeholder (default $REDACTED$).
questions: How do I change the placeholder used by mask_secrets?
What placeholder does mask_secrets use by default?

answer_card.title: mask_secrets parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `_input` (string, required)
- `mask_placeholder` (default `$REDACTED$`): text substituted for each secret
